meta.name: manage-mounts
meta.description: Configure which host directories agent containers can access. View, add, or remove mount allowlist entries. Triggers on "mounts", "mount allowlist", "agent access to directories", "container mounts".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 管理容器可访问的主机目录挂载
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要控制 agent 容器能访问哪些主机目录
copy.tagline_en: Manage which host directories agent containers can access
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to control which host directories agent containers can access

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 可以查看、添加或删除主机目录的挂载白名单，并控制非主代理对这些目录的访问权限（只读或读写）。
howto.when: 当你说出“mounts”、“mount allowlist”、“agent access to directories”等关键词时触发。

say.text: 显示当前的挂载白名单。
say.note: Claude 会读取并展示白名单内容。

say.text: 添加 /data 目录到挂载白名单，设为只读。
say.note: Claude 会验证路径并更新配置。

say.text: 从白名单中移除 /data 目录。
say.note: Claude 会更新配置并提示重启服务。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can view, add, or remove host directories from the mount allowlist, and control whether non-main agents have read-only or read-write access.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you mention "mounts", "mount allowlist", "agent access to directories", or similar keywords.

say_en.note: Claude reads and displays the allowlist.

say_en.text: Add /data directory to the mount allowlist as read-only.
say_en.note: Claude validates the path and updates config.
Claude updates config and prompts to restart service.
